comments.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>This is really great. You need to send all the LaTeX to the course staff. <break/><break/>And a minor legal technicality correction: Course Notes are derivative works from lectures given by faculty. Consequently, you cannot pass them down to friends. :-)</paragraph><paragraph>But it is our intention to take the notes and collect them together into a curated body of edited notes (building on the editing that has already happened for the optimization section) and put them on the course website for others to see.  For example, these even get Prof. Ranade's name wrong lol. </paragraph></document>
comments.document:
This is really great. You need to send all the LaTeX to the course staff. 

And a minor legal technicality correction: Course Notes are derivative works from lectures given by faculty. Consequently, you cannot pass them down to friends. :-)

But it is our intention to take the notes and collect them together into a curated body of edited notes (building on the editing that has already happened for the optimization section) and put them on the course website for others to see.  For example, these even get Prof. Ranade's name wrong lol.
